parts.name: Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the bottle, made of glass, forming the largest part of the container.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the primary storage area for liquids or other contents inside the bottle.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move relative to other parts.

parts.name: Neck
parts.Basic_description: This is the neck of the bottle, made of glass, connecting the body to the closure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a narrow passage for pouring and supports the closure mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move relative to the body.

parts.name: Closure
parts.Basic_description: This is the closure or cap of the bottle, made of plastic, fitting onto the neck.
parts.Functional_description: It seals the bottle to prevent leakage and can be removed or replaced for access to the contents.
parts.Movement_description: It can be rotated or pulled off to open and pushed or screwed on to close.
